replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
For non-chat related offenses, we require video evidence, so the report is denied (next time please try to record). But as I can see why you reported, I'll give you the why I think the player could have not been spawnkilling:

  • Without context, we cannot see if player just attempted to run past their spawn to get to a certain point of the map, and just hit a player that hit him so that he wouldn't kill him. Spawnkilling is staying at the spawn with the sole intention of killing the player, which could not have been the case.

Regards, Javi
